baseline.rule: Re-read latest dev before implementation; current code wins over stale line-level assumptions.

tasks.title: Re-read dev and audit CharacterCard consumers
doneWhen: Current dev HEAD is recorded.
All consumers of apps/web/src/components/ui/character-card.tsx are identified.
Character Edit preview compatibility is protected before shared primitive edits.

tasks.title: Fix card navigation and action priority
doneWhen: Fragile sibling full-card overlay architecture is removed or replaced by an equally robust DOM structure.
Card body/name opens contextual details.
Favorite and overflow trigger never navigate.
Edit and unlink retain existing routes/flows.

tasks.title: Refactor roster card presentation and long names
doneWhen: Roster card is compact without changing Character Edit preview defaults.
No roster vertical hover transform remains.
Importance, POV, status and hidden fields form one metadata group.
Primary name is max two lines with safe token breaking.
Tooltip appears only for measured overflow and remeasures on resize/text change.
Different global name appears as a muted secondary line.

tasks.title: Remove redundant roster total chip
doneWhen: Roster summary no longer repeats total Characters.
Favorites, POV and hidden warning remain.
Book Details tab count is unchanged.

tasks.title: Add focused browser and unit regression coverage
doneWhen: Browser-capable test proves overflow menu and Favorite do not navigate while card body does.
Long-name overflow/non-overflow behavior is covered with real layout measurement.
Existing roster tests remain green.
Character Edit preview remains compatible.

tasks.title: Run quality gates and report
doneWhen: pnpm --filter @app/web test passes.
pnpm --filter @app/web typecheck passes.
pnpm lint has no new errors.
pnpm format:check passes.
pnpm --filter @app/web test:storybook passes if browser stories/tests changed.
No backend/shared schema/generated API/dependency changes are present.
